messages:
anna-cs: customer reports that when they remove users from an Okta group the corresponding roles in our app are not being removed. they see 200s in the SCIM logs but roles stick around. customer: acme-corp (org id: org_9X7). can someone triage?

devon-support: thanks anna. do we have a repro user + example SCIM payload from the Okta push? any correlation id from our side?

anna-cs: repro user is user_1234 (anna@acme.com). here's the group patch Okta sent at 2024-12-04T14:11:22Z — they said the group was removed in Okta but our role stayed:```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "replace",
      "path": "members",
      "value": [
        { "value": "user_1234", "display": "anna@acme.com" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}```
we also have our provisioning log lines: `scim:patch groupId=g-77 status=200 op=replace members=1 correlation=CORR-5a2b`

pranay-eng: hmm. two quick questions: (1) does Okta sometimes send `externalId` for groups? (2) are we matching members by `value` only or also by `userName`/emails?

kevin-identity: Okta can be configured to use group.externalId or group.displayName for pushes. we've seen customers with secondaryEmails set on users — Okta's member object may include an email that is not the user's primary userName. our current group->role mapping uses the SCIM member value and matches that to `user.externalId` only. if Okta is sending `userName` / email (or a secondary email) as the member display, our match can miss on deletion.

devon-support: that aligns with the customer note: they recently enabled `secondaryEmails` in Okta. could explain how a delete shows 200 but we never find the user to remove the role.

anna-cs: attaching an example user create from the customer (okta user payload):```json
{
  "id": "user_1234",
  "userName": "anna@acme.com",
  "emails": [ {"value": "anna@acme.com", "type": "work", "primary": true}, {"value": "anna+alt@acme.com", "type": "other"} ],
  "externalId": "ext-anna-9"
}```
notice the secondary email `anna+alt@acme.com`. Okta may include that in membership display sometimes.

pranay-eng: proposed fix: when processing group membership ops, attempt matching in this order: (1) member.value -> user.id or user.externalId, (2) member.display or member.value if looks like an email -> match against user.userName and user.emails[*].value, (3) fallback to search by canonicalized email (lowercase, strip plus tags). also emit a debug warning when we find a member that matches only via secondary email so we can monitor frequency.

kevin-identity: +1. also recommend a periodic reconciliation job per-org that checks role memberships against current SCIM groups and repairs orphans. we should scope that to enterprise orgs first.

devon-support: what's the quick remediation for acme? can we run a one-off reconcile and remove the stuck roles today? customer is pushing.

pranay-eng: yes — we have an internal admin endpoint /internal/admin/scim/reconcile?org=org_9X7 that will scan groups -> roles and remove mismatches. i'll run it in dry-run first and post the output. need an owner to trigger with proper audit log.

kevin-identity: i'll trigger with audit tag `cs-reconcile-acme-20241204` after pranay posts dry-run. we should capture before/after counts.

pranay-eng: dry-run output (truncated):```text
found 1 orphaned role mapping for user_1234 -> role dev-tools (group g-77)
match reason: member matched via secondary email `anna+alt@acme.com` not via externalId
```

anna-cs: pls proceed, customer is on the line. I'm pinging them that we're about to run remediation and will confirm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin-identity: running reconcile now (will include rollback window & audit). starting at 2024-12-04T15:05Z.

okta-bot: SCIM reconcile job started by kevin-identity (job id job_4492).

pranay-eng: reconcile finished. results (summary):```text
removed 1 role mapping for user_1234 (dev-tools)
no other orphans found in org_9X7
operation id: op-cc12
```

anna-cs: customer confirmed roles are gone, thanks everyone :tada:

devon-support: follow-ups: (1) PR to update member matching logic (pranay), (2) add dry-run alert to notify when secondary-email matches exceed threshold (kevin), (3) schedule reconcile job as nightly for enterprise orgs (product + infra). can we get timelines?

pranay-eng: i'll open PR today with unit tests and a feature flag. aim to land in staging by 2024-12-08, production rollout via feature flag 2024-12-15 pending perf run.

kevin-identity: i'll add the dry-run metric and alert today.

anna-cs: great. closing the support ticket after we have PR link + postmortem note. i'll draft the customer-facing summary.

devon-support: adding final ask — include the correlation id logs we found so support can more quickly triage similar cases: `CORR-5a2b` and op id `op-cc12`.

anna-cs: noted. thanks team, closing on our side.
